main.description: A single, mutable per-account streak/stats record, edited in place like a profile. It also doubles as atkuzu's declaration / signaling record: its presence signals that an account plays atkuzu, and its deletion signals opt-out. Created on first play, even before any stats accrue.

currentStreak.description: Consecutive solved puzzles up to the most recent played puzzle.

lastPuzzleNumber.description: Puzzle number of the most recent completed puzzle, used to detect streak breaks.

updatedAt.description: When this record was last updated.

test.description: True if the current values reflect test writes only, not real completions. Since this record is a singleton (`self`), a real write always overwrites a test one and omits this field.
